notes.title: important update
notes.content: [p]hey there, it's Dusky, uhh, if you can believe me I did not know people were posting on the forums.[/p][p]Yeah the demo is broken, been broken for a while, currently working on fixing that![/p][p]Very sorry for the wait. [b]Should[/b] be fixed by the end of the year, will feature some new things too - nothing crazy, but how do some new music tracks and character animations sound?[/p][p][/p][p]I made a post on Twitter that goes a little more in depth on my recent identity crisis/brush with death/all that fun stuff.[/p][p][url="https://x.com/H4voc_Studios/status/1953353621623419002"]https://x.com/H4voc_Studios/status/1953353621623419002[/url][/p][p]I HIGHLY recommend, if you are still here, you read that if you read anything from me.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p](they forced me to upload a cover image so look at our new logo i guess)[/p]
